newsitem.title: UK: BLUE CIRCLE LEADS SECTOR UP, DKB SAYS BUY.
newsitem.headline: BLUE CIRCLE LEADS SECTOR UP, DKB SAYS BUY.

text.p: Shares in Britain's biggest cement producer Blue Circle Industries Plc rose sharply on Friday in a buoyant building sector helped by a Kleinwort Benson "buy" recommendation and the outlook for UK interest rates.
Blue Circle climbed 24p to 450-1/2p in trade of over one million shares by 0805 GMT. Meanwhile, building materials group RMC Group Plc gained 53-1/2p to 11.26 stg.
Elsewhere, Redland Plc put on 11-1/2p to 320p and Wolseley added 16-1/2p to 501-1/2p.
Market sources said Dresdner Kleinwort Benson had upgraded Blue Circle to a "buy" today, but further details were not immediately available.

The rest of the sector was also boosted by a weaker pound and expectations that UK interest rates will remain steady for the time being, after Thursday's rate hike, which was the fourth in as many months.
With interest rates possibly remaining steady at 7.0 percent, investors were hoping that buoyancy in the housing market would not be threatened.
